arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arms the alarm system. Response: ok, open (open sensors), bypassed.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: armed_away = Away, armed_home = Home/Night, armed_vacation = Vacation

code.name: PIN
code.description: Only needed if arming requires a PIN

force.name: Arm anyway
force.description: Bypass open sensors instead of aborting

disarm.name: Disarm
disarm.description: Disarms the alarm system with a PIN.

check.name: Check open sensors
check.description: Returns the open or unavailable sensors of a mode.
